mentions.name: Setsumei
mentions.description: iOS app that helps learners of Japanese by explaining grammar: enter a Japanese sentence, tap Analyze, and the app automatically detects, highlights, and explains the grammar. A public TestFlight is available.
mentions.problem: Learning Japanese grammar is difficult; the author built it to help themselves learn Japanese.
mentions.audience: People learning Japanese who want grammar explained.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on another iOS to help me learn Japanese, this time for explaining grammar. Put in a Japanese sentence, tap Analyze and you get grammar detected, highlighted, explained.
mentions.author: ig0r0
